goals.title: Prepare Payments API for the next release
goals.description: Verify release readiness of Payments API v2, identify the current accountable owner, explain unresolved release blockers and associated architectural decisions, and coordinate the required technical investigation.

tasks.title: Investigate PAY-104 webhook race condition and specify distributed lock remediation
tasks.description: Analyze Stripe latency retry pattern, evaluate ADR-0042 idempotency constraints, and prepare technical findings with acceptance criteria for mutex barrier before release sign-off.

decisions.question: How to prevent double charges and duplicate payment transactions during checkout retries?
decisions.outcome: ADR-0042: Mandated 48-hour UUID idempotency keys on client write operations with 5s distributed Redis mutex.

decisions.question: Who is the primary accountable technical owner of Payments API v2 and Payments Settlement Service?
decisions.outcome: Ownership transferred from David Kim to Asha Patel to lead v2 concurrency architecture and rollout.
